book.name: Matiu
book.title: Matiu Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Matiu girumalena

content: Iesu bosapua kutumba wai
Iesu gagalo ema uduudu diasane me wawe alala diamone wanase,
“E atenla walama nata bedewe Pasowa odawa walamawa segalepi ita sawana sa bedewe mo Apana Otopa koros osowe bosapua baiwa nanantopu.”
Tane walama sawo pirisi debamau ita apana eiau pirisi ionoidoa ebowa Kaiapas duwe auwene
gagalontone inta banusaia Iesu werego wadape bosapona baiwa.
Mo epe dewantoie, ipawa mo inseie waiase, “No Iesu mai oda walamawe wadataitue bosataa rua, apana uara ewanepue nuau kadilepio onamba enapua sawa.”
Betani iwa Iesu mampe nuawadawada debama dewasade
Iesu Betani bedewe apana ebowa Saimon duwe wandie. Saimon sa mapo kero kito wadawadala inalena.
Iesu sape nana nadio i dea ia asiwa bonabonaua esapa dugi euda bedewe imaala wadene wisene ita Iesu uwawa osowe memen. Tane esa sa malesawa ipa debamaia.
Iesu warorowa dewa ema ewane nuau kadileno wane waienase, “Dima baiwa esa ema di memenaubene kadisan?
Esa bonabonaua ema gimaralepe mane debamaia wadape apana nuaparelala saumopona.”
Iesu aiau ema atenlene diamone wanase, “Dima baiwa me epe dieile nuawa kadisailana?
Apana nuaparelala walama uduudu e do wanlempe saumonuna rua. Tane ne mai walama uduudu e do wainento oniadewasaneanuna, dia.
I ema esa bonabonaua ne etena osowe memen, sa ipa ne dobosaneapua baiwa imaanen.
Ne ulaipa dialedina, bola uduudu bedewe Gagalo euda amonantompa dima i ema dewasana do gagalowa wampa, me dudunawa insempaa baiwa.”
Iudas Iesu nanaleide
Ema aupe wawe alala 12 bedeuwo dea ebowa waia Iudas Iskariot pirisi debamau mampo alene
waitaramone wanase, “Naita ne Iesu witalawosapo e sipoa dima ne neana?” Mo epe etane mane silwa wisiantona 30 me waneiena.
Ita Iudas mane wadene tauma walamawa euda wadepidewae Iesu nanalepie mo witaposapia onioniawaleidie wandie.
Iesu wawe alala do rawi nanawa nai
Tane Ierusalem bedewe oda walama uwawe apana bured sasanasiawaia nai, walama sawo Iesu wawe alala me mampe wimone waitarasane waienase, “Naepe e meneedia no Pasowa nanawa imaasata e baia?”

Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Aitane Ierusalem bedewe apana ne atentena donsane diane wanase, ‘Debamamba ema epe wade: Ne walamanaida tauma maidalen. Ne menanedia wanawo alala do e duawo Pasowa nanawa nata.’”
Wawe alala Iesu diamona rua dewasane ita Pasowa nanawa imaasaiena.
Rawileidio Iesu wawe alala 12 do wimone nana napua baiwa aisintone waimoiena.
Mo nana naio bedewe Iesu wane wanase, “Ne ulaipa dialedina, apana dea e bedelawo ne laga mampe nanalepie kotu apanawa mamposapi.”
Wawe alala aia ema etane mo nuau pareidaleno ita deadea Iesu waitarasane waienase, “Tatamba, ne dia, ba?”
Iesu sipoamone wanase, “Apana mida tauma bured wadene ne nata urai bedewe aneite naitana, me ipa sa ne wadanepie nanalepi.

Apana Otopa mampe epe segalepio bolepi, me umanawa buka bedewe girumaleno winedia rua. Tane me mida Apana Otopa dabuasapie laga mampe kotu apanawa mamposapia me matangela rebarebaida donsapie poka etepi! Poka sa etepia sawa eulena inawa me gamowa epona.”
Mape Iudas mida Iesu nanalepia wane wanase, “Debamana, mai ne, ba?” Iesu sipoasane wanase, “Mebaawa ipa e waiana.”
Iesu saua sanaa saualeide
Mo nana naio Iesu bured wadene God auwasane ita ampuiasane wawe alala wanamodie wanase, “Wadane nana, ema ipa ne etena.”
Tauma me redu wadene God auwasane ita mo wanamodie wanase, “E uduudu ema nana.
Ema ipa ne osinana memenaubena apana uara kadiu insadabua baiwa. Inta ema bedewe ne sauana sanaa ulaipaleide.
Ne dialedina, nana ema naitana dialepio aupe ne wain mai napa, dia, ideita ne Mamana God gonaawa wisepie ipawanalepio tauma ne e do osowe nata.”
Nana aupe mo wadapos sasawa waieno dialeno Ierusalem ene nomone wadi Olib osowe anton.
Iesu Pita mampe gagaloleide
Sape Iesu wawe alala diamone wanase, “Ande tadina e uduudu ne koaneane eneane aitanatuwapi buka girumalena rua. God buka bedewe ema epe wadi wadiase,

content.text: ‘Ne sipsip onioniau apanawa epapabolepi ita sipsip auweie waimoia deaantoputuwapi.’

content: E uduudu ne eneane aitanatuwapio bonteapa. Tane bo bedewe enapawineape bautantape Galiliwa anteapo e wanawo wilene doineana.”
Pita sipoasane wanase, “Naita apana uduudu e koaepue ita eepu ne mai e koaepe eepa, dia.”
Iesu me aiawa leusane wanase, “Ne ulaipa dieedina, ande tadinawa eida ne wakoana wae lagaitaa walama natadea, muriwa kanka aiawa wapi.”
Tane Pita wane wanase, “Ne mai e wakoaepe lagaa wapa, diaida! Naita ne do boneapua, ide rua e nata bontata.” Tane wawe alala isiwa aia ipa deawaa waiena.
Iesu Gesemani bedewe rauparileide
Tauma Iesu wawe alala do sala awopawe ebowa waia Gesemani bedewe wimone me mo diamone wanase, “E mape wanlempo ne sisi anteape rauparintapa.”
Iesu Pita ita Sebedi obampa nata otamone me do anton. Tane me nuawa pola wano ita nuapareidalene
mo diamone wanase, “Ne nuana nuapare nopeidosana bonepia rua etedina. Mape wanlempe ne do onioniantonte iwuntonte wainenta!”

Iesu eseanama alene dogo osowe dunelene rauparilene wanase, “Mako, rua ba dia, poka etaetala reduwa ne mainawoleidia e wade nambesawo ne mai napa? Tane mai ne menanedia rua dewasawo segalepi, dia, e insaisaaida segalepi ne mainawo.”
Tauma me leulene wisene wawe alala natadea ituntoio dommone ita Pita diene wanase, “E mai walama kampaida os ne do onioniantape iwuntepona rua, ba?”

Ita me do diamone wanase, “E rauparitonune emoitonune os wanlempa, rubu iompo e badowa enakasaitane nanausana rua, mai dia. E nuala uduudu menasadia badowa enonuna, tane ete oauaraleidie teinaaisileidia wankoaitonuna menasade.”
Iesu mo osowe emone alene rauparilene wanase, “Mamana, naita poka etaetala reduwa ema mai wadaaubea rua ne napa e insaisaa rua.”
Me leulene wisene wawe alala ituntoio dommon, ipawa mo emau lauidalen.
Mape Iesu mo emone alene raupariwa ompa deawaa wan.

Tane me raupariwa diasane leulene wawe alala mampo wisene diamone wanase, “E ideita ituitile bubuaitilana, ba? Ewana, ne walamanaida maidalen. Taumaida Apana Otopa dabuasapuo kadiwa dewalala witapolepi.
Enano ana, mida ne wadanepie nanalepia iede.”
Iesu wadeiitudede
Iesu gagaloleidioma Iudas wisen, me bauta wawe alala 12 bedeuwo dea. Apana uaraia witapo isima ita koinau otamone me do wimoiena. Apana sa uara pirisi debamau ita apana eiau waaubamoiena.
Ita mida Iesu nanalepia me bauta werego apana diaimaamone wanase, “Mida ne isuruasapino ewana, me ipa sa wadanaitudepi.”
Iudas wisene tauwadea Iesu mampelene wanase, “Debamana, ne auwaedina!” Me epe wane ita isuruasan.
Tane Iesu me diene wanase, “Sona, dima awa wiena dewasaa!” Tauma apana nomonaaubene Iesu wadanaitudeiena.
Iesu sowa dea dewa ema ewene isimawa teinenaubene pirisi debama nolawa dewalala dea epene ita me asiwa tonpunden.
Tane Iesu me diene wanase, “Isimaa leusae aupawe ane ea! Ipawa apana mida isimau teineiaubeia mo ona bedewe bontopu.
E ateiten ba dia, ne rua os Mamana mampe iririnteapono ita me tauwadea ensel uaraia waaubamopona ne baina?
Dima buka bedewe girumalena tauma ideita ulaipalepi, tane Mamana ensel waaubamopono dima buka bedewe girumalena ando ambi segalepona?”

Mape Iesu apana uara diamone wanase, “E isimala ita koinala do otele mainawo wilen wadaneana baiwa, ewaewawa abo ne witakadilala apanawa rua. Ne e do wainite walama ruawantedine God duwa bedewe waeuwantedine wainedine, tane e mai wadaneapona, dia.
Tane dewa ema uduudu segaleidia dima peroweta bukawa bedewe girumalena ulaipalepia baiwa.” Mape wawe alala uduudu tauwadea Iesu ene sauwo antonatuwaiena.
Iesu apana debamau danauwo kotuleide
Anaana waeuwalala ita apana eiau pirisi ionoidoa ebowa Kaiapas duwa bedewe auwene waimoie ita mo mida Iesu wadanaitudeiena banlene antone apana debamau auweia bolawe wimoiena.
Mo Iesu banlene antoio Pita awoa Iesu wawe warorosane pirisi ionoidoa duwa enedia bolawa mampelene dima segalepio ewepia baiwa iwu apana do aisintone waimoie.
Tane pirisi debamau ita Ius onionialala uduudu laga apanawa banumoie. Apana sa laga mampe benemasikintopono mo Iesu bosapona baiwa.
Laga apanawa uara wimone Iesu benemasikiwantone tane mai kadiwa da donsapona Iesu bosapu. Tane kotu gagalowa ompa osowe apana nata mo uara danauwo enane
benemasikintone waienase, “Apana ema epe wane wanase, ‘Ne God duwa kadisapa ita walama natadea bedewe ne osowe wadapa.’”
Mape pirisi ionoidoa enenwisene Iesu diene wanase, “Apana ema e wawueie benemantoio eteiana, ba? E mo wawueia sipoa leusae eba inaitaa gagalowa waa, ba di epe enona?”
Tane Iesu dainakasalene mai dima wapona, dia. Tauma pirisi ionoidoa me diene wanase, “E Godida wanwankasalala ebowa mampe ulaipaida waa: Naita e Keriso God Otopa no dianewo atentata!”
Iesu leusane wanase, “E eba ipa sa waiana! Tane ne e uduudu dialedina: E ando Apana Otopa God mukamukaua witapa on deneuwe waimpo ita do uba giouwa asiasi iompo ewana.”
Mape pirisi ionoidoa nuawa kadiidaleno me garawa siolene wanase, “E uduudu etalana me God wakadisasano, dima baiwa benemasiki apanawa da baibuntitana?
Tauma e ambi inseilana no dima dewasata me mampe?” Mo sipoasane waienase, “Me epe wana baiwa ideita bolepi.”
Mape mo Iesu namba seseisaiena, apana isiwa witapo epaubasane ita isiwa me sainapa epane
wane waienase, “Naita e Kerisoewo dianea mida e epeedio poka eteiana!”
Pita Iesu lagawa wade
Pita kotu duwa enedia adiwe peloo wandio pirisi nolawa dewalala iwa rialene me mampelene diene wanase, “E do Galili Iesuwa do leilana apanawa!”
Tane Pita mo uduudu danauwo lagalene wanase, “Ne mai atenteapona e dima umanawa waiana.”
Ema aupe Pita nosene inta nope aleidio sape i da me ewene apana sape eneia diamone wanase, “Apana ema Nasaret Iesuwa do laia apanawa.”
Me osowe lagalene wanase, “Ne God ebowa mampe ulaipa wadina, apana sa ne mai atenteapona, dia!”
Ema aupe walama kerauda os bedewe apana sape eneia Pita mampentone diane waienase, “Ulaipa, e ipa Iesu sowa dea, e aiaa bumpa etaeta sabamoede!”
Pita meba ula wane wanase, “Ne laganteapono God matangelaneapona, apana sa ne mai atenteapona, dia!” Pita ema wano dialeno kanka aiawa wan.
Tane Pita insendewalen dima Iesu bauta wane wanase, “E ne wakoana wae lagaitaa walama natadea, muriwa kanka aiawa wapi.” Ita Pita nuawa pareidaleno nosene peloo alene ke debamaia wan.
